events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with geopolitical instability and strategic rivalries increasing. This could lead to a regional war, affecting global markets and economies.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation could lead to increased oil prices, benefiting oil services companies. On the other hand, emerging markets could be negatively affected by the geopolitical instability.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or geopolitical tensions ease

events.title: Nvidia AI Spending
events.summary: Nvidia has announced a multiyear technology partnership with SK hynix to advance memory for AI factories. This could lead to increased demand for Nvidia's AI products.
events.reasoning: The partnership with SK hynix could increase Nvidia's market share in the AI industry, benefiting the company's stock price.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when Nvidia's earnings report is released

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
